query: SELECT * FROM duckdb_views() WHERE database_name='perf' ORDER BY schema_name,view_name
rows: Browsable reference of the perf worker's decode functions — one row per object, with the columns it returns. Browse it to discover the surface before decoding a capture.

rows.vgi.doc_llm: A browsable, no-argument reference of every decode table function the perf worker exposes: one row per function with its name, kind, the category it belongs to, a one-line summary, and the comma-separated list of columns it returns. Query it to discover what to call and what each call returns before you have a perf.data capture in hand — it takes no arguments and always returns the same rows. To actually decode a capture, call the named function with a perf.data path or the raw bytes.
rows.vgi.doc_md: A no-argument catalog of the perf worker's decode functions (`object_name`, `object_kind`, `category`, `summary`, `result_columns`) — browse `perf.main.functions` to discover what each function returns before decoding a capture.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the decode table functions and the columns each one returns.","sql":"SELECT object_name, result_columns FROM perf.main.functions WHERE object_kind = 'table function' ORDER BY object_name"}]
rows.vgi.title: perf Decode Functions

rows: CREATE VIEW "functions" AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('samples', 'table function', 'Profile Samples', 'One row per profiling sample (PERF_RECORD_SAMPLE) with its raw call chain.', 'time, pid, tid, cpu, ip, period, event, callchain'), ('mmaps', 'table function', 'Address Space', 'One row per memory mapping (MMAP/MMAP2) with the build-id that makes a raw ip interpretable.', 'pid, tid, addr, len, pgoff, filename, build_id'), ('comms', 'table function', 'Capture Context', 'One row per command/thread-name record (COMM).', 'pid, tid, comm, time'), ('events', 'table function', 'Capture Context', 'One row per recorded event attribute — what was sampled and how.', 'event_id, name, type, config, sample_period, sample_freq'), ('meta', 'table function', 'Capture Context', 'A single row of capture-wide HEADER_* metadata.', 'hostname, arch, nrcpus, perf_version, cmdline, total_events')) AS valueslist) AS t(object_name, object_kind, category, summary, result_columns);
